topic: Sky Sports News item: Cameron Bancroft accuses Pat Cummins of knowing about the sandpaper plan (2018 ball-tampering), presented via studio shot and quote graphics
hero: Cameron Bancroft (shown as photo in graphic)
hero_role: protagonist of the news item (the one speaking out)
hook: Wide studio shot: presenter standing before large video wall with Bancroft/team photos and quote 'It was not just the three of us. It was the whole team.'
subtitle_style: Quote cards: white sans text on blue gradient panel, bold headline 'Bancroft speaks out', attribution bottom-left; photo of Bancroft in whites on right
transition_summary: Studio hold ~20 s then cut to full-screen quote graphics; wipe-swipe between quote cards; very slow rhythm (~1 cut per 20 s)
audio_note: Presenter voice-over reading quotes (transcript: 'Now to some bombshell quotes from Cameron Bancroft as sandpaper gate...')

reuse_segments.what: Studio presenter in front of video wall
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Sky Sports brand; recreate in own studio set
